title: World country choropleth
intent: Compare values across real country boundaries with an equal-area world projection.

ai.create: Create a country-level Equal Earth choropleth from world-atlas countries-110m, converting TopoJSON once and rendering all 177 countries as keyed native geo marks.
ai.maintain: Update country values without replacing boundary geometry; preserve atlas identity, responsive projection fitting, stable country keys, binned fills, and theme-aware borders.
